name: SG Corporation
summary: Based in Seoul, South Korea, SG Corporation is a fashion enterprise primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of woven clothing, with a strong focus on the South Korean market. Its extensive product range includes formal dresses, casual apparel, outerwear, and various jacket styles. The company caters to women with its ab.f.z and ab.plus brands, while men's fashion is offered under the BASSO and BASSO hommes labels. In addition to its domestic operations, SG Corporation extends its reach globally, exporting its goods to 50 countries. Established in 1964, the firm was previously known as SGWICUS Corporation until its rebranding to SG Corporation in March 2010.
